41 PERSONALISING YOUR CAR

--- page 42 ---
Blackline Specification.*
For a dramatic, purposeful look, the Blackline
Specification adds a brooding character to
the Flying Spur. Replacing all exterior polished
chrome with all-black brightware, it includes
side window surrounds, wing vents and lower
door brightware, rear bumper brightware,
front headlamp bezels, radshell matrix,
surround and centre bar, door handles, rear
number plate surround, rear lamp bezels and
exhaust tailpipes.
Styling Specification.*
Offering a range of additions in carbon fibre,
the material of choice for the motorsport
industry, the Styling Specification adds to
your car’s dynamic exterior. Elements include
a front splitter, side sills, rear diffuser and
boot lip spoiler.
*Cost option.
